numbering: Standard 700-verse canon; Chapter 13 has 34 verses and excludes Arjuna's alternate opening question.
sourceChapterWithLineNumbers:
1:   Krishna.
2:   Yet farther will I open unto thee
3:   This wisdom of all wisdoms, uttermost,
4:   The which possessing, all My saints have passed
5:   To perfectness. On such high verities
6:   Reliant, rising into fellowship
7:   With Me, they are not born again at birth
8:   Of Kalpas, nor at Pralyas suffer change!
9: 
10:   This Universe the womb is where I plant
11:   Seed of all lives! Thence, Prince of India, comes
12:   Birth to all beings! Whoso, Kunti's Son!
13:   Mothers each mortal form, Brahma conceives,
14:   And I am He that fathers, sending seed!
15: 
16:   Sattwan, Rajas, and Tamas, so are named
17:   The qualities of Nature, "Soothfastness,"
18:   "Passion," and "Ignorance." These three bind down
19:   The changeless Spirit in the changeful flesh.
20:   Whereof sweet "Soothfastness," by purity
21:   Living unsullied and enlightened, binds
22:   The sinless Soul to happiness and truth;
23:   And Passion, being kin to appetite,
24:   And breeding impulse and propensity,
25:   Binds the embodied Soul, O Kunti's Son!
26:   By tie of works. But Ignorance, begot
27:   Of Darkness, blinding mortal men, binds down
28:   Their souls to stupor, sloth, and drowsiness.
29:   Yea, Prince of India! Soothfastness binds souls
30:   In pleasant wise to flesh; and Passion binds
31:   By toilsome strain; but Ignorance, which blots
32:   The beams of wisdom, binds the soul to sloth.
33:   Passion and Ignorance, once overcome,
34:   Leave Soothfastness, O Bharata! Where this
35:   With Ignorance are absent, Passion rules;
36:   And Ignorance in hearts not good nor quick.
37:   When at all gateways of the Body shines
38:   The Lamp of Knowledge, then may one see well
39:   Soothfastness settled in that city reigns;
40:   Where longing is, and ardour, and unrest,
41:   Impulse to strive and gain, and avarice,
42:   Those spring from Passion--Prince!--engrained; and where
43:   Darkness and dulness, sloth and stupor are,
44:   'Tis Ignorance hath caused them, Kuru Chief!
45: 
46:   Moreover, when a soul departeth, fixed
47:   In Soothfastness, it goeth to the place--
48:   Perfect and pure--of those that know all Truth.
49:   If it departeth in set habitude
50:   Of Impulse, it shall pass into the world
51:   Of spirits tied to works; and, if it dies
52:   In hardened Ignorance, that blinded soul
53:   Is born anew in some unlighted womb.
54: 
55:   The fruit of Soothfastness is true and sweet;
56:   The fruit of lusts is pain and toil; the fruit
57:   Of Ignorance is deeper darkness. Yea!
58:   For Light brings light, and Passion ache to have;
59:   And gloom, bewilderments, and ignorance
60:   Grow forth from Ignorance. Those of the first
61:   Rise ever higher; those of the second mode
62:   Take a mid place; the darkened souls sink back
63:   To lower deeps, loaded with witlessness!
64: 
65:   When, watching life, the living man perceives
66:   The only actors are the Qualities,
67:   And knows what rules beyond the Qualities,
68:   Then is he come nigh unto Me!
69: 
70:   The Soul,
71:   Thus passing forth from the Three Qualities--
72:   Whereby arise all bodies--overcomes
73:   Birth, Death, Sorrow, and Age; and drinketh deep
74:   The undying wine of Amrit.
75: 
76:   Arjuna.
77:   Oh, my Lord!
78:   Which be the signs to know him that hath gone
79:   Past the Three Modes? How liveth he? What way
80:   Leadeth him safe beyond the threefold Modes?
81: 
82:   Krishna.
83:   He who with equanimity surveys
84:   Lustre of goodness, strife of passion, sloth
85:   Of ignorance, not angry if they are,
86:   Not wishful when they are not: he who sits
87:   A sojourner and stranger in their midst
88:   Unruffled, standing off, saying--serene--
89:   When troubles break, "These be the Qualities!"
90:   He unto whom--self-centred--grief and joy
91:   Sound as one word; to whose deep-seeing eyes
92:   The clod, the marble, and the gold are one;
93:   Whose equal heart holds the same gentleness
94:   For lovely and unlovely things, firm-set,
95:   Well-pleased in praise and dispraise; satisfied
96:   With honour or dishonour; unto friends
97:   And unto foes alike in tolerance;
98:   Detached from undertakings,--he is named
99:   Surmounter of the Qualities!
100: 
101:   And such--
102:   With single, fervent faith adoring Me,
103:   Passing beyond the Qualities, conforms
104:   To Brahma, and attains Me!
105: 
106:   For I am
107:   That whereof Brahma is the likeness! Mine
108:   The Amrit is; and Immortality
109:   Is mine; and mine perfect Felicity!
110: 
111:   HERE ENDS CHAPTER XIV. OF THE BHAGAVAD-GITA
112:   Entitled "Gunatrayavibhagayog,"
113:   Or "The Book of Religion by Separation from the Qualities."

paratext.text:
HERE ENDS CHAPTER XIV. OF THE BHAGAVAD-GITA
  Entitled "Gunatrayavibhagayog,"
  Or "The Book of Religion by Separation from the Qualities."

records.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच।
परं भूयः प्रवक्ष्यामि ज्ञानानां ज्ञानमुत्तमम्।
यज्ज्ञात्वा मुनयः सर्वे परां सिद्धिमितो गताः ॥
records.iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
paraṃ bhūyaḥ pravakṣyāmi jñānānāṃ jñānamuttamam
yajjñātvā munayaḥ sarve parāṃ siddhimito gatāḥ
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
Krishna.
  Yet farther will I open unto thee
  This wisdom of all wisdoms, uttermost,
  The which possessing, all My saints have passed
  To perfectness.

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 14.1 The Blessed Lord said I will again declare (to thee) that supreme knowledge, the best of all knowledge, having known which all the sages have gone to the supreme perfection after this life.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 14.1 "Lord Shri Krishna continued: Now I will reveal unto the Wisdom which is beyond knowledge, by attaining which the sages have reached Perfection.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 14.1 The Blessed Lord said I shall speak again of the supreme Knowledge, the best of all knowledges, by realizing which all the contemplatives reached the highest Perfection from here.

records.sanskrit:
इदं ज्ञानमुपाश्रित्य मम साधर्म्यमागताः।
सर्गेऽपि नोपजायन्ते प्रलये न व्यथन्ति च ॥
records.iast:
idaṃ jñānamupāśritya mama sādharmyamāgatāḥ
sarge.api nopajāyante pralaye na vyathanti ca
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
On such high verities
  Reliant, rising into fellowship
  With Me, they are not born again at birth
  Of Kalpas, nor at Pralyas suffer change!

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 14.2 They who, having taken refuge in this knowledge, have attained to unity with Me, are neither born at the time of creation nor are they disturbed at the time of dissolution.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 14.2 Dwelling in Wisdom and realising My Divinity, they are not born again when the universe is re-created at the beginning of every cycle, nor are they affected when it is dissolved.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 14.2 Those who attain identity with Me by resorting of this Knowledge are not born even during creation, nor do they suffer pain during dissolution.

records.sanskrit:
मम योनिर्महद् ब्रह्म तस्मिन्गर्भं दधाम्यहम्।
सम्भवः सर्वभूतानां ततो भवति भारत ॥
records.iast:
mama yonirmahad brahma tasmingarbhaṃ dadhāmyaham
sambhavaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ tato bhavati bhārata
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
This Universe the womb is where I plant
  Seed of all lives! Thence, Prince of India, comes
  Birth to all beings!

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 14.3 My womb is the great Brahma; in that I place the germ; thence, O Arjuna, is the birth of all beings.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 14.3 The eternal Cosmos is My womb, in which I plant the seed, from which all beings are born, O Prince!

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 14.3 My womb is the great-sustainer. In that I place the seed. From that, O scion of the Bharata dynasty, occurs the birth of all things.

records.sanskrit:
सर्वयोनिषु कौन्तेय मूर्तयः सम्भवन्ति याः।
तासां ब्रह्म महद्योनिरहं बीजप्रदः पिता ॥
records.iast:
sarvayoniṣu kaunteya mūrtayaḥ sambhavanti yāḥ
tāsāṃ brahma mahadyonirahaṃ bījapradaḥ pitā
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
Whoso, Kunti's Son!
  Mothers each mortal form, Brahma conceives,
  And I am He that fathers, sending seed!

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 14.4 Whatever forms are produced, O Arjuna, in any womb whatsoever, the great Brahma is their womb and I am the seed-giving father.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 14.4 O illustrious son of Kunti! Through whatever wombs men are born, it is the Spirit Itself that conceives, and I am their Father.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 14.4 O son of Kunti, whatever forms are born from all the wombs, of them the great-sustainer is the womb; I am the father who deposits the seed.

records.sanskrit:
सत्त्वं रजस्तम इति गुणाः प्रकृतिसम्भवाः।
निबध्नन्ति महाबाहो देहे देहिनमव्ययम् ॥
records.iast:
sattvaṃ rajastama iti guṇāḥ prakṛtisambhavāḥ
nibadhnanti mahābāho dehe dehinamavyayam
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
Sattwan, Rajas, and Tamas, so are named
  The qualities of Nature, "Soothfastness,"
  "Passion," and "Ignorance." These three bind down
  The changeless Spirit in the changeful flesh.

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 14.5 Purity, passion and inertia these alities, O Arjuna, born of Nature, bind fast in the body, the embodied, the indestructible.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 14.5 Purity, Passion and Ignorance are the Qualities which the Law of nature bringeth forth. They fetter the free Spirit in all beings.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 14.5 O mighty-armed one, the alities, viz sattva, rajas and tamas, born of Nature, being the immutable embodies being to the body.

records.sanskrit:
तत्र सत्त्वं निर्मलत्वात्प्रकाशकमनामयम्।
सुखसङ्गेन बध्नाति ज्ञानसङ्गेन चानघ ॥
records.iast:
tatra sattvaṃ nirmalatvātprakāśakamanāmayam
sukhasaṅgena badhnāti jñānasaṅgena cānagha
records.speaker: Krishna

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 14.6 Of these, Sattva, which from its stainlessness is luminous and healthy, binds by attachment to happiness and by attachment to knowledge, O sinless one.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 14.6 O Sinless One! Of these, Purity, being luminous, strong and invulnerable, binds one by its yearning for happiness and illumination.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 14.6 Among them, sattva, being pure, [Nirmala, pure-transparent, i.e., capable of resisting any form of ignorance, and hence as illuminator, i.e.a revealer of Consciousness.] is an illuminator and is harmless. O sinless one, it binds through attachment to happiness and attachment to knowledge.

records.sanskrit:
रजो रागात्मकं विद्धि तृष्णासङ्गसमुद्भवम्।
तन्निबध्नाति कौन्तेय कर्मसङ्गेन देहिनम् ॥
records.iast:
rajo rāgātmakaṃ viddhi tṛṣṇāsaṅgasamudbhavam
tannibadhnāti kaunteya karmasaṅgena dehinam
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
And Passion, being kin to appetite,
  And breeding impulse and propensity,
  Binds the embodied Soul, O Kunti's Son!
  By tie of works.

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 14.7 Know thou Rajas to be of the nature of passion, the source of thirst (for sensual enjoyment) and attachment; it binds fast, O Arjuna, the embodied one by attachment to action.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 14.7 Passion, engendered by thirst for pleasure and attachment, binds the soul through its fondness for activity.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 14.7 Know rajas to be of the nature of passion, born of hankering and attachment. O son of Kunti, that binds the embodied one through attachment to action.

records.sanskrit:
तमस्त्वज्ञानजं विद्धि मोहनं सर्वदेहिनाम्।
प्रमादालस्यनिद्राभिस्तन्निबध्नाति भारत ॥
records.iast:
tamastvajñānajaṃ viddhi mohanaṃ sarvadehinām
pramādālasyanidrābhistannibadhnāti bhārata
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
But Ignorance, begot
  Of Darkness, blinding mortal men, binds down
  Their souls to stupor, sloth, and drowsiness.

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 14.8 But know thou Tamas to be born of ignorance, deluding all embodied beings; it binds fast, O Arjuna, by heedlessness, indolence and sleep.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 14.8 But Ignorance, the product of darkness, stupefies the senses in all embodied beings, binding them by chains of folly, indolence and lethargy.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 14.8 On the other hand, know tamas, which deludes all embodied beings, to be born of ignorance. O scion of the Bharata dynasty, that binds through inadvertence, laziness and sleep.

records.sanskrit:
सत्त्वं सुखे सञ्जयति रजः कर्मणि भारत।
ज्ञानमावृत्य तु तमः प्रमादे सञ्जयत्युत ॥
records.iast:
sattvaṃ sukhe sañjayati rajaḥ karmaṇi bhārata
jñānamāvṛtya tu tamaḥ pramāde sañjayatyuta
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
Yea, Prince of India! Soothfastness binds souls
  In pleasant wise to flesh; and Passion binds
  By toilsome strain; but Ignorance, which blots
  The beams of wisdom, binds the soul to sloth.

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 14.9 Sattva attaches to happiness, Rajas to action, O Arjuna, while Tamas verily shrouding knowledge attaches to heedlessness.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 14.9 Purity brings happiness, Passion commotion, and Ignorance, which obscures wisdom, leads to a life of failure.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 14.9 O scion of the Bharata dynasty, sattva attaches one to happiness, rajas to action, while tamas, covering up knowledge, leads to inadvertence also.

records.sanskrit:
रजस्तमश्चाभिभूय सत्त्वं भवति भारत।
रजः सत्त्वं तमश्चैव तमः सत्त्वं रजस्तथा ॥
records.iast:
rajastamaścābhibhūya sattvaṃ bhavati bhārata
rajaḥ sattvaṃ tamaścaiva tamaḥ sattvaṃ rajastathā
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
Passion and Ignorance, once overcome,
  Leave Soothfastness, O Bharata! Where this
  With Ignorance are absent, Passion rules;
  And Ignorance in hearts not good nor quick.

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 14.10 Now Sattva arises (prevails), O Arjuna, having overpowered Rajas and Tamas; nor Rajas, having overpowered Sattva and Tamas; and now Tamas, having overpowered Sattva and Rajas.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 14.10 O Prince! Purity prevails when Passion and Ignorance are overcome; Passion, when Purity and Ignorance are overcome; and Ignorance when it overcomes Purity and Passion.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 14.10 O scion of the Bharata dynasty, sattva increases by subduing rajas and tamas, rajas by overpowering sattva and tamas, and tamas by dominating over sattva and rajas.

records.sanskrit:
सर्वद्वारेषु देहेऽस्मिन्प्रकाश उपजायते।
ज्ञानं यदा तदा विद्याद्विवृद्धं सत्त्वमित्युत ॥
records.iast:
sarvadvāreṣu dehe.asminprakāśa upajāyate
jñānaṃ yadā tadā vidyādvivṛddhaṃ sattvamityuta
records.speaker: Krishna

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 14.11 When through every gate (sense) in this body, the wisdom-light shines, then it may be known that Sattva is predominant.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 14.11 When the light of knowledge gleams forth from all the gates of the body, then be sure that Purity prevails.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 14.11 When the illumination that is knowledge radiates in this body through all the doors (of the senses), then one should know that sattva has increased greatly.

records.sanskrit:
लोभः प्रवृत्तिरारम्भः कर्मणामशमः स्पृहा।
रजस्येतानि जायन्ते विवृद्धे भरतर्षभ ॥
records.iast:
lobhaḥ pravṛttirārambhaḥ karmaṇāmaśamaḥ spṛhā
rajasyetāni jāyante vivṛddhe bharatarṣabha
records.speaker: Krishna

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 14.12 Greed, activity, the undertaking of actions, restlessness, longing these arise when Rajas is predominant, O Arjuna.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 14.12 O best of Indians! Avarice, the impulse to act and the beginning of action itself are all due to the dominance of Passion.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 14.12 O best of the Bharata dynasty, when rajas becomes predominant, these come into being: avarice, movement, undertaking of actions, unrest and hankering.

records.sanskrit:
अप्रकाशोऽप्रवृत्तिश्च प्रमादो मोह एव च।
तमस्येतानि जायन्ते विवृद्धे कुरुनन्दन ॥
records.iast:
aprakāśo.apravṛttiśca pramādo moha eva ca
tamasyetāni jāyante vivṛddhe kurunandana
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
and where
  Darkness and dulness, sloth and stupor are,
  'Tis Ignorance hath caused them, Kuru Chief!

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 14.13 Darkness, inertness, heedlessness and delusion these arise when Tamas is predominant, O Arjuna.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 14.13 Darkness, stagnation, folly and infatuation are the result of the dominance of Ignorance, O joy of the Kuru-clan!

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 14.13 O descendant of the Kuru dynasty, when tamas predominates these surely [i.e. without exception.-M.S.] come into being: non-discrimination and inactivity, inadvertence and delusion.

records.sanskrit:
यदा सत्त्वे प्रवृद्धे तु प्रलयं याति देहभृत्।
तदोत्तमविदां लोकानमलान्प्रतिपद्यते ॥
records.iast:
yadā sattve pravṛddhe tu pralayaṃ yāti dehabhṛt
tadottamavidāṃ lokānamalānpratipadyate
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
Moreover, when a soul departeth, fixed
  In Soothfastness, it goeth to the place--
  Perfect and pure--of those that know all Truth.

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 14.14 If the embodied one meets with death when Sattva is predominant, then he attains to the spotless worlds of the knowers of the Highest.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 14.14 When Purity prevails, the soul on quitting the body passes on to the pure regions where live those who know the Highest.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 14.14 When an embodied one undergoes death while sattva is exclusively prodominant, then he attains the taintless worlds of those who know the highest (entities).

records.sanskrit:
रजसि प्रलयं गत्वा कर्मसङ्गिषु जायते।
तथा प्रलीनस्तमसि मूढयोनिषु जायते ॥
records.iast:
rajasi pralayaṃ gatvā karmasaṅgiṣu jāyate
tathā pralīnastamasi mūḍhayoniṣu jāyate
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
If it departeth in set habitude
  Of Impulse, it shall pass into the world
  Of spirits tied to works; and, if it dies
  In hardened Ignorance, that blinded soul
  Is born anew in some unlighted womb.

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 14.15 Meeting death in Rajas, he is born among those who are attached to action; and dying in Tamas, he is born in the womb of the senseless.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 14.15 When Passion prevails, the soul is reborn among those who love activity; when Ignorance rules, it enters the wombs of the ignorant.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 14.15 When one dies while rajas predominates, he is born among people attached to activity. Similarly, when one dies while tamas predominates, he takes birth among the stupid species.

records.sanskrit:
कर्मणः सुकृतस्याहुः सात्त्विकं निर्मलं फलम्।
रजसस्तु फलं दुःखमज्ञानं तमसः फलम् ॥
records.iast:
karmaṇaḥ sukṛtasyāhuḥ sāttvikaṃ nirmalaṃ phalam
rajasastu phalaṃ duḥkhamajñānaṃ tamasaḥ phalam
records.speaker: Krishna

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 14.16 The fruit of good action, they say, is Sattvic and pure, verily the fruit of Rajas is pain, and ignorance is the fruit of Tamas.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 14.16 They say the fruit of a meritorious action is spotless and full of purity; the outcome of Passion is misery, and of Ignorance darkness.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 14.16 They say that the result of good work is pure and is born of sattva. But the result of rajas is sorrow; the result of tamas is ignorance.

records.sanskrit:
सत्त्वात्सञ्जायते ज्ञानं रजसो लोभ एव च।
प्रमादमोहौ तमसो भवतोऽज्ञानमेव च ॥
records.iast:
sattvātsañjāyate jñānaṃ rajaso lobha eva ca
pramādamohau tamaso bhavato.ajñānameva ca
records.speaker: Krishna

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 14.17 From Sattva arises knowledge, and greed from Rajas; heedlessness and delusion arise from Tamas, and also ignorance.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 14.17 Purity engenders Wisdom, Passion avarice, and Ignorance folly, infatuation and darkness.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 14.17 From sattva is born knowledge [Knowledge acired through the sense-organs.], and from rajas, verily, avarice. From tamas are born inadvertence and delusion as also ignorance, to be sure.

records.sanskrit:
ऊर्ध्वं गच्छन्ति सत्त्वस्था मध्ये तिष्ठन्ति राजसाः।
जघन्यगुणवृत्तिस्था अधो गच्छन्ति तामसाः ॥
records.iast:
ūrdhvaṃ gacchanti sattvasthā madhye tiṣṭhanti rājasāḥ
jaghanyaguṇavṛttisthā adho gacchanti tāmasāḥ
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
Those of the first
  Rise ever higher; those of the second mode
  Take a mid place; the darkened souls sink back
  To lower deeps, loaded with witlessness!

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 14.18 Those who are seated in Sattva go upwards; the Rajasic dwell in the middle; and the Tamasic, abiding in the function of the lowest Guna, go downwards.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 14.18 When Purity is in the ascendant, the man evolves; when Passion, he neither evolves nor degenerates; when Ignorance, he is lost.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 14.18 People who conform to sattva go higher up; those who conform to rajas stay in the middle; those who conform to tamas, who conform to the actions of the lowest ality, go down.

records.sanskrit:
नान्यं गुणेभ्यः कर्तारं यदा द्रष्टानुपश्यति।
गुणेभ्यश्च परं वेत्ति मद्भावं सोऽधिगच्छति ॥
records.iast:
nānyaṃ guṇebhyaḥ kartāraṃ yadā draṣṭānupaśyati
guṇebhyaśca paraṃ vetti madbhāvaṃ so.adhigacchati
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
When, watching life, the living man perceives
  The only actors are the Qualities,
  And knows what rules beyond the Qualities,
  Then is he come nigh unto Me!

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 14.19 When the seer beholds no agent other than the Gunas and knows That which is higher than they, he attains to My Being.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 14.19 As soon as man understands that it is only the Qualities which act and nothing else, and perceives That which is beyond, he attains My divine nature.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 14.19 When the witness sees none other than the alities as the agent, and knows that which is superior [i.e. different from.] to the alities, he attains My nature.

records.sanskrit:
गुणानेतानतीत्य त्रीन्देही देहसमुद्भवान्।
जन्ममृत्युजरादुःखैर्विमुक्तोऽमृतमश्नुते ॥
records.iast:
guṇānetānatītya trīndehī dehasamudbhavān
janmamṛtyujarāduḥkhairvimukto.amṛtamaśnute
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
The Soul,
  Thus passing forth from the Three Qualities--
  Whereby arise all bodies--overcomes
  Birth, Death, Sorrow, and Age; and drinketh deep
  The undying wine of Amrit.

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 14.20 The embodied one having crossed beyond these three Gunas out of which the body is evolved, is freed from birth, death, decay and pain, and attains to immortality.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 14.20 When the soul transcends the Qualities, which are the real cause of physical existence, then, freed from birth and death, from old age and misery, he quaffs the nectar of immortality.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 14.20 Having transcended these three alities which are the origin of the body, the embodied one, becoming free from birth, death, old age and sorrows, experiences Immortality.

records.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच।
कैर्लिङ्गैस्त्रीन्गुणानेतानतीतो भवति प्रभो।
किमाचारः कथं चैतांस्त्रीन्गुणानतिवर्तते ॥
records.iast:
arjuna uvāca
kairliṅgaistrīnguṇānetānatīto bhavati prabho
kimācāraḥ kathaṃ caitāṃstrīnguṇānativartate
records.speaker: Arjuna

arnold.content:
Arjuna.
  Oh, my Lord!
  Which be the signs to know him that hath gone
  Past the Three Modes? How liveth he? What way
  Leadeth him safe beyond the threefold Modes?

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 14.21 Arjuna said What are the marks of him who has transcended the three alities, O Lord? What is his conduct and how does he go beyond these three alities?

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 14.21 Arjuna asked: My Lord! By what signs can he who has transcended the Qualities be recognized? How does he act? How does he live beyond them?

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 14.21 Arjuna said O Lord, by what signs is one (known) who has gone beyond these three alities? What is his behaviour, and how does he transcend these three alities?

records.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच।
प्रकाशं च प्रवृत्तिं च मोहमेव च पाण्डव।
न द्वेष्टि सम्प्रवृत्तानि न निवृत्तानि काङ्क्षति ॥
records.iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
prakāśaṃ ca pravṛttiṃ ca mohameva ca pāṇḍava
na dveṣṭi sampravṛttāni na nivṛttāni kāṅkṣati
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
Krishna.
  He who with equanimity surveys
  Lustre of goodness, strife of passion, sloth
  Of ignorance, not angry if they are,
  Not wishful when they are not:

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 14.22 The Blessed Lord said When light, activity and delusion are present, he hates them not, nor does he long for them when they are absent.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 14.22 Lord Shri Krishna replied: O Prince! He who shuns not the Quality which is present, and longs not for that which is absent;

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 14.22 The Blessed Lord said O son of Pandu, he neither dislikes illumination (knowledge), activity and delusion when they appear, nor does he long for them when they disappear.

records.sanskrit:
उदासीनवदासीनो गुणैर्यो न विचाल्यते।
गुणा वर्तन्त इत्येवं योऽवतिष्ठति नेङ्गते ॥
records.iast:
udāsīnavadāsīno guṇairyo na vicālyate
guṇā vartanta ityevaṃ yo.avatiṣṭhati neṅgate
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
he who sits
  A sojourner and stranger in their midst
  Unruffled, standing off, saying--serene--
  When troubles break, "These be the Qualities!"

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 14.23 He who, seated like one unconcerned, is not moved by the alities, and who, knowing that the alities are active, is self-centred and moves not.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 14.23 He who maintains an attitude of indifference, who is not disturbed by the Qualities, who realises that it is only they who act, and remains calm;

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 14.23 He who, sitting like one indifferent, is not distracted by the three alities; he who, thinking that the alities alone act, remains firm and surely does not move;

records.sanskrit:
समदुःखसुखः स्वस्थः समलोष्टाश्मकाञ्चनः।
तुल्यप्रियाप्रियो धीरस्तुल्यनिन्दात्मसंस्तुतिः ॥
records.iast:
samaduḥkhasukhaḥ svasthaḥ samaloṣṭāśmakāñcanaḥ
tulyapriyāpriyo dhīrastulyanindātmasaṃstutiḥ
records.speaker: Krishna

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 14.24 Who is the same in pleasure and pain, who dwells in the Self, to whom a clod of earth, stone and gold are alike, who is the same to the dear and the unfriendly, who is firm, and to whom censure and praise are as one.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 14.24 Who accepts pain and pleasure as it comes, is centred in his Self, to whom a piece of clay or stone or gold are the same, who neither likes nor dislikes, who is steadfast, indifferent alike to praise or censure;

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 14.24 He to whom sorrow and happiness are alike, who is established in his own Self, to whom a lump of earth, iron and gold are the same, to whom the agreeable and the disagreeable are the same, who is wise, to whom censure and his own praise are the same;

records.sanskrit:
मानापमानयोस्तुल्यस्तुल्यो मित्रारिपक्षयोः।
सर्वारम्भपरित्यागी गुणातीतः स उच्यते ॥
records.iast:
mānāpamānayostulyastulyo mitrāripakṣayoḥ
sarvārambhaparityāgī guṇātītaḥ sa ucyate
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
satisfied
  With honour or dishonour; unto friends
  And unto foes alike in tolerance;
  Detached from undertakings,--he is named
  Surmounter of the Qualities!

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 14.25 Who is the same in honour and dishonour, the same to friend and foe, abandoning all undertakings he is said to have transcended the alities.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 14.25 Who looks equally upon honour and dishonour, loves friends and foes alike, abandons all initiative, such is he who transcends the Qualities.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 14.25 He who is the same under honour and dishonour, who is eally disposed both towards the side of the friend and of the foe, who has renounced all enterprise,-he is said to have gone beyond the alities.

records.sanskrit:
मां च योऽव्यभिचारेण भक्तियोगेन सेवते।
स गुणान्समतीत्यैतान्ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते ॥
records.iast:
māṃ ca yo.avyabhicāreṇa bhaktiyogena sevate
sa guṇānsamatītyaitānbrahmabhūyāya kalpate
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
And such--
  With single, fervent faith adoring Me,
  Passing beyond the Qualities, conforms
  To Brahma, and attains Me!

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 14.26 And he who serves Me with unswerving devotion, he, crossing beyond the alities, is fit for becoming Brahman.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 14.26 And he who serves Me and only Me, with unfaltering devotion, shall overcome the Qualities, and become One with the Eternal.

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 14.26 And he who serves Me through the unswerving Yoga of Devotion, he, having gone beyond these alities, alifies for becoming Brahman.

records.sanskrit:
ब्रह्मणो हि प्रतिष्ठाहममृतस्याव्ययस्य च।
शाश्वतस्य च धर्मस्य सुखस्यैकान्तिकस्य च ॥
records.iast:
brahmaṇo hi pratiṣṭhāhamamṛtasyāvyayasya ca
śāśvatasya ca dharmasya sukhasyaikāntikasya ca
records.speaker: Krishna

arnold.content:
For I am
  That whereof Brahma is the likeness! Mine
  The Amrit is; and Immortality
  Is mine; and mine perfect Felicity!

witnesses.author: Swami Sivananda
witnesses.text: 14.27 For I am the abode of Brahman, the immortal and the immutable, of everlasting Dharma and of absolute bliss.

witnesses.author: Shri Purohit Swami
witnesses.text: 14.27 For I am the Home of the Spirit, the continual Source of immortality, of eternal Righteousness and of infinite Joy."

witnesses.author: Swami Gambirananda
witnesses.text: 14.27 For I am the Abode of Brahman-the indestructible and immutable, the eternal, the Dharma and absolute Bliss.
